# Map of the EEAaq package

How the functions of the package call one another. The diagram is in
`EEAaq_function_map.svg` (and `.pdf` for print); the narrative version is
the vignette `function-map`. The three files are generated by
`dev/make-function-map.R` in the GitHub repository: the layers are declared
in the script, the calls are found by a static scan of the sources with
the R parser when the map is generated, so they cannot drift from the code.
Exported functions are marked with `*`. A function defined inside another
one (a nested helper) is counted as part of its parent.

## Layers

### Metadata, read at run time from GitHub

`EEAaq_get_dataframe`*, `EEAaq_get_stations`*

### Builders of Support_files/, used by the maintainers only

`get_stations`, `get_pollutants`, `get_NUTS`, `get_LAU`

### Download and storage

`EEAaq_get_data`*, `handle_dates`, `is_EEAaq_df`*, `EEAaq_export`*, `EEAaq_import`*

### Description and time aggregation

`EEAaq_summary`*, `EEAaq_time_aggregate`*, `my_summarise`

### Maps

`EEAaq_map_stations`*, `EEAaq_idw_map`*, `code_extr`

## Calls, function by function

Only the calls to other functions of the package are listed, with the
metadata tables asked to `EEAaq_get_dataframe()`.

* `EEAaq_get_dataframe`* (`R/EEAaq_get_dataframe.R`, line 34) -> no package function
* `EEAaq_get_stations`* (`R/EEAaq_get_stations.R`, line 20) -> `EEAaq_get_dataframe`*; reads `stations`
* `get_stations` (`R/get_stations.R`, line 14) -> `EEAaq_get_dataframe`*; reads `NUTS`, `LAU`
* `get_pollutants` (`R/get_pollutant.R`, line 13) -> no package function
* `get_NUTS` (`R/get_NUTS.R`, line 9) -> no package function
* `get_LAU` (`R/get_LAU.R`, line 14) -> no package function; nested helpers `download_lau`, `download_lau_city`
* `EEAaq_get_data`* (`R/EEAaq_get_data.R`, line 40) -> `EEAaq_get_dataframe`*, `handle_dates`; reads `pollutant`, `stations`, `NUTS`; nested helpers `my_function`
* `handle_dates` (`R/handle_dates.R`, line 14) -> no package function
* `is_EEAaq_df`* (`R/is_EEAaq_df.R`, line 29) -> no package function
* `EEAaq_export`* (`R/EEAaq_export.R`, line 29) -> `EEAaq_get_dataframe`*; reads `LAU`, `NUTS`
* `EEAaq_import`* (`R/EEAaq_import.R`, line 34) -> no package function
* `EEAaq_summary`* (`R/EEAaq_summary.R`, line 40) -> `EEAaq_get_stations`*; nested helpers `EEA_summ`, `g_length`, `cor_mat`
* `EEAaq_time_aggregate`* (`R/EEAaq_time_aggregate.R`, line 39) -> `my_summarise`
* `my_summarise` (`R/EEAaq_time_aggregate.R`, line 173) -> no package function
* `EEAaq_map_stations`* (`R/EEAaq_map_stations.R`, line 54) -> `EEAaq_get_dataframe`*, `code_extr`; reads `stations`, `pollutant`, `LAU`, `NUTS`
* `EEAaq_idw_map`* (`R/EEAaq_idw_map.R`, line 117) -> `EEAaq_get_dataframe`*, `code_extr`; reads `stations`, `pollutant`, `LAU`, `NUTS`; nested helpers `my_plot`, `lays`
* `code_extr` (`R/code_extr.R`, line 8) -> no package function

## Objects

| Object | Returned by | Accepted by |
|---|---|---|
| `EEAaq_df` | `EEAaq_get_data()` | `EEAaq_summary()`, `EEAaq_time_aggregate()`, `EEAaq_map_stations()`, `EEAaq_export()`, `is_EEAaq_df()` |
| `EEAaq_df_sfc` | `EEAaq_import()` | `EEAaq_time_aggregate()`, `EEAaq_export()`, `is_EEAaq_df()` |
| `EEAaq_taggr_df`, `EEAaq_taggr_df_sfc` | `EEAaq_time_aggregate()`, with one pollutant | `EEAaq_idw_map()` |
| `EEAaq_taggr_list` | `EEAaq_time_aggregate()`, with more than one pollutant: all of them in `TimeAggr`, one `EEAaq_taggr_df` per pollutant in `TimeAggr_byPollutant` | `EEAaq_idw_map()` |

## Network access

* The EEA Air Quality Download Service: `EEAaq_get_data()`, through the
  API (`ParquetFile/urls`), which returns the URLs of the parquet files.
* `Support_files/` on GitHub, through `EEAaq_get_dataframe()`: `EEAaq_export`*, `EEAaq_get_data`*, `EEAaq_get_dataframe`*, `EEAaq_get_stations`*, `EEAaq_idw_map`*, `EEAaq_map_stations`*, `EEAaq_summary`*, `get_stations`.
* The builders of `Support_files/` read the EEA station metadata, the
  EIONET vocabulary of pollutants and the Eurostat GISCO boundaries.

Nothing of this may run while CRAN checks the package: the examples of
these functions are in `\dontrun{}` and the main vignette is precomputed.
